verdict.rationale: Name.com's search page points users to browsing premium names and expiring domains, and its availability-check API returns pricing for each result, so premium names exist as a search path. Nothing shows premium pricing explicitly flagged in search results, or a marketplace or broker service for acquiring taken names. Missing for 10: explicit premium-price display in search results, an aftermarket marketplace or broker path for registered names, any in-depth docs on premium handling, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, premium and aftermarket domains are first-class — premium pricing shown in search, and a marketplace or broker path for taken names

citations.quote: browsing expiring domains, premium names, and bulk search options.
Checks whether up to 50 domain names are purchasable and returns **discovery** pricing for each result.
